name: ifg
description: For tax professionals. Claude gets the official tax text in force on the date of the facts, with its status, its versions and a clickable link to the official source, together with the guidance, case law and treaties linked to it. Covers 32 European jurisdictions (all 27 EU member states, French overseas territories, Switzerland and cantons, the UK, Monaco, Andorra, Liechtenstein) and Israel, plus bilateral tax treaties and the MLI, EU law, OECD and UN Models. Requires an IFG account.
